, gl2vec is a novel network embedding approach for network classification in static and temporal directed network. gl2vec uses graphlet distributions to represent network features and compares them against a null model. gl2vec significantly improves the classification accuracy of state-of-the-art approaches on real-world applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
graphlets are a powerful representation for directed networks, especially when combined with the null model.
gl2vec can be applied to both static and temporal networks and can provide additional features to existing methods that can improve their accuracy by 5% to 10%.
graphlet-based network representations can be used to improve the performance of state-of-the-art network embedding algorithms in network classification tasks.
